text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I take into consideration today's
weather, wind
speed, and humidity...
Yes, this should work.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. I've made
some
revisions to my calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The more refined a theory, the simpler it

becomes. Keep your eyes on me,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the ultimate result of my

calculations—total victory!
